nodes.description: Cryptic donor use retains intronic sequence or truncates an exon; intron-1 pseudoexon inclusion provides another route to premature termination codons. Local intron-removal order helps explain why the studied donor variants do not simply skip an in-frame collagen exon. RNA-folding predictions are a possible explanation for site choice, not direct evidence of in vivo RNA structure.

nodes.description: The knockout model lacks alpha2(I) chains and forms homotrimeric type I collagen.
